lines.line: Classic Indian board games — ludo, snakes & ladders
lines.note: Only Ludo 9 sells; three other ludo SKUs and all generic Board Game SKUs are dead; no snakes & ladders.
Plain ludo and chess exist, but no travel, pocket or magnetic format of any game.

lines.line: Chess sets — plastic, wooden and tournament
lines.note: Three chess sets sell; four more listed dead. No chess clocks or spare-piece SKUs.

lines.line: Carrom board — full size and mid size
lines.note: One unbranded carrom board SKU, 3 sold in 12m, currently zero stock.
Coins and strikers are stocked but barely sell (q1 and q4); no boric powder SKU.
Single generic Business game SKU; no Monopoly or branded title.
No Scrabble, tambola/housie or word game of any kind in the catalogue.
No UNO, Jenga or any social card game; 'uno' matches only Unomax pens.
No playing-card deck; 'card' hits are greeting cards and cardigans.
Only unnamed, never-sold generic 'Board Game' SKUs — no modern/strategy title at this price point.
Zero puzzle SKUs of any kind in the 21,479-item catalogue.
No jigsaw puzzles at any piece count.
Toy Cube 6015 sells well at ~Rs63/pc; generic name, so a cheap puzzle cube rather than a branded speedcube.
No wire/metal/wooden brain-teaser puzzles; only the plastic toy cube above.
One generic block set, 6 sold in 12m, out of stock since Dec-25.
No branded bricks or magnetic tiles; only the one generic block set above.
Bt Stuff Toy 01 sells at ~Rs180/pc; roughly 100 other Stuff Toy SKUs are listed but all dead.
Size is not stated on most plush SKUs; the one marked 'Medium' and all large-lot plush have zero sales.
No blind box, collectible series or licensed character plush.
Om Doll 36 is a real mover (163 pcs); no doll clothes or accessory packs.

lines.searched: kitchen set, doctor, tea set, role
lines.note: Doctor set sells; kitchen sets barely (1 pc). No tool kit or shop/cash-register set.

lines.searched: toy car, jcb, diecast, pull back, bike
lines.note: Bt Car 86 is a strong seller (193 pcs, Rs50k); all unbranded, no Centy/Hot Wheels die-cast.
Only the battery dancing dog sells; both Remote Car SKUs are dead.
Strong AA/AAA line (Eveready + Panasonic); no 9V or LR44/CR2032 button cells seen.

lines.line: Baby rattles, teethers, squeeze & bath toys (0-18 m)
lines.note: One rattle set on the master, never sold; no teethers or bath toys at all.
No stacking rings, shape sorters, play gyms or cot toys.
No ride-on, walker, tricycle or rocking toy; 'Toy Bike' is a small toy, not a ride-on.
No bicycles and no helmets; 'cycle' hits are Cycle brand agarbatti.

lines.line: Kick scooters, skates & skateboards + protective gear
lines.note: Single skates SKU, zero sales and zero stock; no scooters, skateboards or pads.

lines.line: Play dough, modelling clay & kinetic sand
lines.best_match: Skoodle Modelling Clay 50 Gm Mini Canister
lines.note: Modelling clay only (Kores/Skoodle); no play-dough playsets or kinetic sand.
No DIY craft kits; the only 'kits' are Doms/Camlin painting kits, which belong to the colouring line.
Doms painting kits, colour pencils, crayons and colouring books all sell and are in stock.
Only coloured paper sheets sell; every glitter tube SKU is dead; no beads, googly eyes or pom-poms.
No science, robotics or working-model kits of any kind.

lines.searched: alphabet, abacus, flash card, learnin, sorter
lines.note: One alphabet toy on the master, never sold; no abacus, flash cards or magnetic letters.
No microscope, telescope, magnifier or optics set.
Bats and balls both live and in stock; no stumps set among the matches.
Shuttles sell and are stocked (116); the only racket SKUs (Yonex) are dead — the racquet half is missing in practice.
Footballs, volleyballs and basketballs all sold in 12m; the one pump SKU (Spark Football Pump) is dead.

lines.line: Table tennis — bats, balls, portable nets
lines.note: One TT bat sold (6 pcs, now zero stock); the Stiga TT ball is listed but never sold. No nets.
No dart board, sling-puck, bowling or finger-basketball; 'hockey' is a field-hockey stick.
Both flying discs listed with zero sales; no skipping rope or hoop (nylon rope is household).
Bubble toys sell (63 pcs) but are out of stock; no kites, yo-yos or whistles — 'kite sheet' is paper.
Party balloons exist but no pichkari, water gun or water-balloon pack.
No fidget spinner, pop-it, squishy or slime; generic toy SKUs are unnamed and priced above this band.
Only sticker sheets match, and they sell slowly; no marbles, whistles, tops or tattoo sheets.
Gift packs exist only as FMCG (J&J/Himalaya baby packs, all dead); no toy return-gift combos.
Balloons and gift packing/sheets are high-frequency lines; no birthday banners or caps seen.
'Wooden' hits are combs, carrom coins and woollens; no wooden pull-along, stacker or eco toy.
Two toy-guitar SKUs on the master, both never sold; no keyboard, harmonica or rhythm set.
Only kitchen containers and dustbins; no toy bin, puzzle mat, cube stand or piece pouch.
